title: Readyz Get API Contract
description: Draft USF-native interface contract for GET /readyz. It promotes the implemented local route metadata into canonical interface-contract coverage while preserving OpenAPI as a lower-authority projection.
aiGuidance: Treat this interface contract as the route authority. Do not infer semantic authority from OpenAPI, route metadata, examples, generated reports, or handler structure.
purpose: Represent readyz.get as a governed GET API route contract for runtime-readiness.
boundary: Local dev/test inbound HTTP boundary GET /readyz; implementation path apps/api/src/server.ts; route classification health-readiness.

requestContract.description: Request semantics for readyz.get bind method, path, operation id, request schema, auth scheme, tenant scope, and required action before implementation handling. Request schema: none.

responseContract.description: Response semantics for readyz.get expose 200 ReadyResponse; error responses use ApiErrorResponse. Audit, PDP, idempotency, rate-limit, correlation, field exposure, observability, gateway, and proof boundaries remain explicit contract terms.
fields: pdpPolicy:public health/readiness route; no tenant or PDP input

security: Auth scheme none; tenant scope none; PDP policy public health/readiness route; no tenant or PDP input; audit policy not audited; provider modes only; idempotency policy not-required; pagination policy none; rate-limit policy local-dev-test readiness probe; live edge rate limit deferred; field exposure policy provider mode summary only; no credentials; observability policy request_count error_count latency local counters only; gateway policy local-dev-test-only gateway-edge-waf-tls-production-posture-deferred; error schema ApiErrorResponse; proof status is bounded local-dev-test evidence with no public API or live-provider claim.
